about.heading: About Pixel Lane
about.subheading: Pixel Lane is a developing smart-city traffic-management project — not yet a deployed commercial product.

building.heading: What we're building
building.body: Pixel Lane is a platform for modeling city road networks as structured data, analyzing traffic on that model, and — over time — simulating and optimizing infrastructure changes before they're made in the real world.

problem.heading: The problem
problem.body: Urban traffic decisions are often made without a shared, precise model of the underlying road network. Bottlenecks are diagnosed informally, infrastructure changes are planned without a way to test their effect first, and emergency vehicles navigate the same signal timing as everyone else. Pixel Lane's goal is to give cities a structured foundation to reason about these problems with data.

approach.heading: Our approach
approach.body: We start from a City Model — a stable, queryable representation of roads and intersections — and build traffic analysis directly on top of it. Every future capability (simulation, emergency priority, computer-vision integration) is designed to sit behind clear boundaries around that same model, rather than being bolted on as a one-off feature.

vision.heading: Vision
vision.body: Long term, we want Pixel Lane to support a simulation-driven digital twin of a city's road network, so that infrastructure and traffic-management changes can be tested before they're deployed. That work is in progress; today, the platform's functional core is city modeling and traffic analysis.

status.heading: Where Pixel Lane stands today
status.body: Pixel Lane is an early-stage, developing project. This policy describes our current, honest position rather than a mature commercial privacy program — it will be expanded as the platform and its user base grow.

collection.heading: What we collect
collection.body: The public website does not currently have an authentication backend, analytics tracking, or a connected contact-form endpoint. Information you type into the contact form on this site is not transmitted anywhere yet — the form is a UI preview. City Model data you create in the application is stored by the Pixel Lane backend for the purpose of displaying it back to you.

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.body: We do not currently set marketing or tracking cookies. A single functional cookie remembers your chosen interface language.
